t: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal launched the National Strategic Trade Command Centre at Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi; developed by the Department of Commerce, its first phase covers DGFT functions such as IEC, Advance Authorisation, EPCG, Certificate of Origin and SCOMET.
India finished the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya with its best-ever tally of 114 medals (30 gold, 35 silver, 49 bronze), surpassing the previous edition's 108.
Double gold medallists shooter Mona Agarwal and jumper Nishad Kumar were named India's flag-bearers for the closing ceremony of the 2026 Asian Para Games in Nagoya, Japan.

Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk arrived in New Delhi on 21 October 2026 on his second official visit to India as Prime Minister (the first was in 2010); India-Poland ties were elevated to a Strategic Partnership in August 2024.

The 8th All India Conference of GRP Chiefs, organised by the Railway Protection Force and presided over by RPF Director General Sonali Mishra, concluded in New Delhi, focusing on intelligence-led policing and railway security.
